I've just stumbled upon a new show by Indy from The Great War YT series, and after watching it's first two episodes, I'm a bit puzzled about the meaning of / reason behind creating the show.

It looks like (pseudo-)documentary or some kind of mockumentary series, but it contains no real/valuable information, and it is filled with some kind of forced humor. So the only reason I can think of for this show to exist is to promote something, but at the same time there is no clear message or direction given to watcher.

The show is about looking for the reasons behind the success of the startups that were created in / related to Stockholm, but none of them is really singled out.

Someone in a comment on YT suggested that this might be an ad for a startup hub from Stockholm, and he could be right, because the hub gets mentioned in both of the episodes, but even so, I still can't decide if I like this kind of creative advertising, and if it can be effective without a clear message.

The first ep is here, the second one here, and I'm curious about where the next episodes will take this stuff, because - regardless if it will work or not - this could be a nice case study for advertising beginners.
